title: [3.0-beta10, 3.0-beta11] Wear OS watch Complications are not working with AAPS
symptom: From version 3.0-beta10 when trying to read BG, IOB etc. data from AAPS watchface into other watchface 'Complications' fields (e.g. 3100 Crucial watchface), no data is shown and only '-' text is shown. AAPS complications worked in earlier beta-versions. Also when reading data from xDrip+ into Complications fields works normally so the problem is not in the watch software or 3100 Crucial watchface.
fix: Fixed by a commit referenced in the thread.
